name: Petra Navarro
summary: Megamundo's chief operating officer, whom Jason and Lucia meet through Valentina.
body: GTABase's character guide lists Petra Navarro as a supporting character and calls her the Chief Operating Officer at Megamundo.
GTABase says she meets Jason and Lucia through Valentina at the opening of the Megamundo Building.

name: Raymond
summary: A San4San-affiliated man who, GTABase says, appears to run a drug house in Vice City.
body: GTABase's character guide says Raymond appears to operate a drug house and is affiliated with the San4San gang.
GTABase's guide pictures him with a frame from Rockstar's Extended Look video.

name: Ernesto
summary: A San4San associate who, GTABase says, runs a drug manufacturing operation with Raymond.
body: GTABase lists Ernesto as a supporting character affiliated with the San4San gang.
GTABase says he and Raymond run a drug manufacturing operation, and also links him to Boobie Ike.

name: Joey
summary: The mechanic at Coastal Auto Care who repairs Jason's '70 Ganado early in the game.
body: GTABase's page for Joey, added on November 18, says he works at Coastal Auto Care, the garage where Jason takes his '70 Ganado for repairs in Just a Scratch.
The app already mentions Joey inside other entries (his free repair in Chapter 1) but has no character entry for him.

name: Stefanie Gates
summary: The prison social worker heard talking to Lucia at the start of the first trailer.
body: GTABase says Stefanie Gates appears to work as a social worker at the Leonida Department of Corrections state prison.
GTABase notes hers is the first voice heard in GTA VI, at the start of Trailer 1, talking to Lucia in her office while Lucia is held at the prison.

name: Phil
summary: The owner of Phil's Ammu-Nation, seen in the Ammu-Nation advert in Trailer 2.
body: GTABase says Phil appears in an Ammu-Nation commercial in Trailer 2 and lists him as the owner of Phil's Ammu-Nation.
GTABase says he seems to be a reimagined Phil Cassidy from the 3D-era games, but notes he is younger and has both arms, unlike the original.

name: Camillo
summary: A Vice City livestreamer and content creator who turns his run-in with Lucia into content.
body: GTABase lists Camillo (also spelled Camilo on the same page) as a livestreamer and content creator based in Vice City.
GTABase says his hairstyle, glasses and manner appear to parody the streamer N3on.

name: Macca the Gator
summary: A pink cartoon alligator from Leonida's hit adult animated show, Macca & Friends.
body: GTABase describes Macca the Gator as a character from Leonida's most popular adult animated TV show, Macca & Friends, and says he is a pink alligator.
GTABase notes he featured heavily in the game's promotional material, including a small statue.

name: Bae-Luxe
summary: One half of the rap duo Real Dimez, alongside Roxy.
body: GTABase's character guide names Bae-Luxe and Roxy as the two members of Real Dimez, friends since high school.
GTABase repeats Rockstar's description that an early hit with the local rapper DWNPLY lifted the duo, and that they are now signed to Only Raw Records.

facts.affiliation: Real Dimez; Roxy; Dre'Quan Priest (Only Raw Records)

name: Roxy
summary: One half of the rap duo Real Dimez, alongside Bae-Luxe.
body: GTABase's character guide names Roxy and Bae-Luxe as the two members of Real Dimez, friends since high school.
GTABase says the duo are signed to Dre'Quan Priest's Only Raw Records.

facts.affiliation: Real Dimez; Bae-Luxe; Dre'Quan Priest (Only Raw Records)
